prologue_intro.speaker: nell
prologue_intro.text: Dad? The water's coming under the door.

prologue_intro.speaker: dad
prologue_intro.text: Grab your coat, Nell. Just your coat. We have to go, right now.

prologue_patch.speaker: patch
prologue_patch.text: Behold! Patch the Magnificent, hero of page one, finest tail in all of Foldwick!

prologue_patch.speaker: patch
prologue_patch.text: ...Why is the page wet? Why is the page MOVING?
